reader.requirement: At --std 85 an index-name used as a subscript (alone or with +/- integer, on a data-name, a condition-name or an ALL-bearing function argument) must be declared by an INDEXED BY phrase of some OCCURS entry in the hierarchy of the table referenced; an index of another table is refused, an index of any level of the same hierarchy is admitted.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.QualifiedIndexName2002: a qualified index-name (IX OF EA) is refused at 85 (§1985 'Index-names cannot be qualified'), admitted at 2002+

reader.edition-search: ScreenIndexNameAssociation and DeclaredInHierarchy consult no edition (read both); the association test is the same at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only around this rule, not in it: 2002+ admits a qualified index-name (IX OF EA), which 1985 refuses (COBOL0900); the hierarchy test itself is identical
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover an index of another table on a one-dimensional element and in a FUNCTION ALL argument; not exercised there are a condition-name subscript, index ± integer, and the legal case of an index of the outer level used at an inner position of a two-dimensional table

probes.printed: COBOL1961 five times: E2 (IX1, CX), E2 (RX, IX1 + 1), condition-name E2-BIG (IX1, CX), E1 (RX), E1 (CX - 1)
probes.expected: each refused: index not in the referenced table's hierarchy
legal: E2 (RX, CX), E2 (RX + 1, CX - 2), E2 (CX, RX) (same hierarchy, any position), condition-name E2-BIG (RX, CX), group R2 (RX)

probes.printed: with E2 (IX1, ALL): COBOL1961; with E2 (RX, ALL) only: 0026
probes.expected: FUNCTION SUM ALL argument (Amendment 1 SR7) applies the same association test; 5+6+7+8 = 26

probes.printed: --std 85: COBOL0900 a qualified index-name requires COBOL-2002; --std 2023: 050

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR3  (4.3.8.2.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The index-names collected while binding the subscripts are checked by declaration identity against every entry of the referenced item's parent chain, so the rule is applied as written ('in the hierarchy'), including condition-names and the ALL argument path. Same arm at 1985 and 2023.

refuter.evidence: sr3x.cob at 85: E2 (RX, SX) (SX indexes a sibling S2 inside the same R2), R2 (CX) (CX is declared under R2, not above it), E3 (RX, N) (RX belongs to T2, which T3 REDEFINES), E2 (RX3, CX): COBOL1961 four times. sr3y.cob: E2 (RX, IX1 + 1) refused COBOL1961; the 2002 forms RX + N and CX + 0 refused COBOL0900 (SR5/SR6 gate). rw1.cob: SOURCE E (IX2) in the report section refused COBOL1961.
